title: aes-192, 9 rounds: Key-dependent sieve / first9-stream8-short [LJW15]

target.description: First nine AES rounds: zero-based 0..8 with whitening k_-1; last MixColumns may be omitted by the explicit output equivalence in Section 3.2.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key and its standard expanded round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: Chosen-plaintext structures with adaptive follow-up32-point queries to candidate delta-sets; the data budget is aggregate across the source trials. Shortened optimization uses16 ordered outputs. All streaming key classes are executed.
assumptions: Total time includes precomputation; all key-space partitions are processed, so streaming is not a weak-key promise.
Time is in nine-round encryptions; memory is in 128-bit words.
